events.title: Update: Scooter Collisions, Harbor Safety & Co-op Sleep Guidance
events.summary: Thanks for playing the MULERUN demo and sharing your feedback! This update includes:Improved scooter collisions to help prevent getting stuck in rocks at high speeds.Closed unsafe harbor openings that allowed players to fall outside the map.Clearer co-op sleep guidance directing players to their assigned bed when a teammate is waiting to sleep.Found a bug? Report it on our Discord. Screenshots, videos, and whether you were playing as the host or a client help us investigate.Thanks for helping us
